entry_point_sweep.reading: the runtime watch is precise - a store in [base, base+124) is a field write by construction - but its coverage is gated by INPUTS, not by the method list. Only the entry point that fills fields from a zeroed receiver produced any, and enriching the receiver was measured to remove the case entirely. So the coverage gap cannot be closed by picking more methods or by fabricating richer inputs: it needs real arguments, which is the live route.
entry_point_sweep.consequence_for_the_session_blocker: this turns 'the live app would help' into a measured statement: the static route is exhausted for this record (rules unstable, precision 1/3), and the runtime route is input-gated in exactly the way a fabricated input cannot fix.
